say:0:1720958001:1.text: Demit spent a huge amount of money on planks, rope, and other supplies under the guise of a public works project, and at the same time rushed to hire a boatman with a smuggling record.
say:0:1720958001:1.source_cn: 一方面，德米特子爵以市政工程为名，花费巨资购置大量木板...

say:1:1720958002:1.text: Planks, rope, a boatman... All of it points to the same thing. Those so-called emergency supplies were never meant for public works. They were for something he couldn't do in the open, such as repairing a boat.
say:1:1720958002:1.source_cn: 木板、麻绳、船工……这些信息指向了同一个目的，这些所谓...
